# Timesheet Tracker

> Timesheet Tracker is a Windows desktop app (Microsoft Store title: "Time Tracker & Timesheet - AI for Jira") that fills your Jira timesheet for you. It runs in the tray, passively records your working day on your own PC, finds Jira issue keys automatically, lets AI sort the rest when you ask, and drafts one worklog per task. You review and confirm; the worklogs go to Jira Cloud or Jira Server/Data Center, or to a CSV file.

Key facts:
- Platform: Windows. Available in the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9n1vml91q1lx
- Price: free download from the Microsoft Store with a 14-day free trial of Pro (no card). Then Pro is $9.99/month or $79/year (yearly is the default, about $6.58/month, 34% less). No free-forever tier. Without a subscription the app keeps recording and shows your day (7-day history, CSV export for today); sending worklogs to Jira and AI sorting need Pro.
- Who it is for: individuals who must log time in Jira (developers, analysts, consultants, agencies). Not an employee-monitoring tool: no screenshots, no keystroke logging, no manager dashboards or team reports.
- Capture: active app, window title, browser tab domain, idle and screen-lock time. Stored locally on the user's PC.
- Matching without AI: Jira keys like ABC-123 are found locally in window titles, URLs and git branch names (e.g. feature/ABC-123-login).
- "Sort my day": one button; AI assigns the remaining time blocks to Jira tasks with a confidence score and drafts one worklog text per task. Only then are masked window titles, app names, domains and durations sent. Full URLs, page content, screenshots, keystrokes and the Jira token are never sent.
- No-AI mode: nothing is sent to an AI provider; unmatched blocks are assigned manually.
- Output: native Jira worklogs (Jira Cloud, Jira Server / Data Center) without duplicates on re-send; CSV export. Planned: Tempo integration, Excel (XLSX) export.
- Contact: help@timesheet-tracker.com

## Comparison summary

Compared with Memtime (local desktop auto-tracker, manual assignment to tasks), Timely (cloud AI time tracker), Tempo Timesheets (Jira add-on ledger with suggestions) and Toggl Track (timer-first tracker), Timesheet Tracker focuses on one job: reconstructing an individual's day locally and turning it into confirmed Jira worklogs with minimal typing.
